configuration.rendering_library: OpenCV raster drawing and PNG encoding; WFDB waveform decoding
configuration.layout: 12 aligned rows; all 10 seconds of each lead; no rhythm-strip duplication
configuration.gain_policy: Reduce the page-wide gain from 10 by powers of two only when any absolute waveform value would exceed the 12-mm half-height. No gain increase, per-lead gain, baseline shift, filtering or sample removal. Plot and record the actual gain and a 1-mV calibration pulse.
configuration.printed_text: Lead names and fixed technical calibration only; no patient ID, ECG ID, demographics, dates, SCP code or diagnostic label
configuration.label_policy: All present SCP-code keys mapped through diagnostic==1; no likelihood threshold. Five overlapping binary targets. Records without mapped diagnostic superclasses retained as images but excluded from the classification manifest.
configuration.split_policy: Official patient folds: 1-8 train, 9 validation, 10 test. Every source ECG rendered once; no split search or class balancing.
configuration.preview_policy: Development only: first training record for each diagnostic superclass plus deterministic training amplitude extremes; freeze style after visual and numerical checks before full generation.
configuration.randomness: None; deterministic clean rendering. No random augmentation or model training.
configuration.limitations: Synthetic clean ECG pages, not real scans or photographs. Rasterization is not lossless signal storage: 500-Hz source points share pixels at 200 horizontal pixels/second. Native waveforms remain the authoritative numerical signal. Page-wide gain can vary and is explicitly calibrated; low-gain and flat-lead records are flagged, not silently discarded.

source_manifest_summary.policy: All present diagnostic SCP keys; no confidence threshold; diagnostic superclass union; multilabel; no class priority, balancing, or History_MI derivation
source_manifest_summary.no_mapped_class_policy: Render page; keep source record and original SCP dictionary; mark classification ineligible rather than treating as an all-negative labeled target
source_manifest_summary.rendering_signal: filename_hr: 500 Hz waveform; filename_lr retained as metadata
source_manifest_summary.patient_id_policy: Normalize integer-valued CSV IDs to decimal integer strings; preserve official fold; all record variants inherit patient fold
source_manifest_summary.image_text_policy: Patient IDs, ECG IDs, labels, SCP codes and other source metadata must not be printed on generated pages
source_manifest_summary.source_waveform_checks: All referenced rate-specific .hea/.dat files exist and are listed in shipped checksums; actual waveform byte verification belongs to renderer
source_manifest_summary.same_rate_duplicate_evidence_scope: Prior verified full audit, not a new waveform duplicate scan
